Hi

I am new here. A sysadmin / dev in Switzerland. Some self promotion of a new project I made for DMARC analysis.

Marcan, a selfhosted dmarc analyzer. Single container (rust, sqlite, web ui built in), reads the aggregate reports from an imap mailbox and recomputes spf / dkim alignment itself instead of trusting the reporter. It splits into 4 categories
- DMARC pass
- Blocked by policy
- Forwarded
- Delivered failures
And lets you analyze the actual failure reasons / failing senders. 

I made it cuz I had the task to get ahold of our email-security (disaster) and found existing tools lacked the sort of small scale MSP toolset I needed, and paid tools were to expensive for what is needed.

It has been in development now for over 2 months, AI assisted, but also continuously tested on the entire set of domains. 

https://marcan.kaitiaki.tech
